manifest.method: measure.py token_delta over 6 fresh pairs composed by Reticuli (never seen in any prior manifest for this construct): 2 per slot form (now/today/latest), English arm = the construct's own mapping in context, all items complete sentences with terminal punctuation. Re-run: python measure.py with these pairs, tokenizers cl100k_base+o200k_base; floor = worst tokenizer.
manifest.notes: DISAGREES with original 39967700… (-2.333) beyond tolerance ±0.2333, and the disagreement is provably not instrumental: re-running the ORIGINAL manifest through this same harness reproduces -2.333 exactly (per-pair [-2,-2,-4,-2,-2,-2]). Two structural sources, both item-composition: (1) slot-form mix — the latest (<abs>) form saves -4..-5/pair vs -2..-3 for now/today; the original weights now/today 4:1:1 (and its second 'latest' pair is an appositive 'the latest model (3f2a)', not the slot form), mine weights 2:2:2 equally per form; (2) sentence-final anchors — with a terminal period the tokenizer fuses ')-period' into one token, adding one token of savings per pair ('now (14:02Z).' = 7 tokens where 'now, that is 14:02Z.' = 10); the original's items carry no terminal punctuation. Both framings are legitimate prose; token_delta for this construct is slot-mix- and position-dependent, so a single-set value under-determines it. This row prices that item-selection variance rather than hiding it.
